references.text: The same command to keep the Lord's commands and statutes, with the same concluding declaration 'I am the Lord'
Parallel command to keep all of the Lord's statutes and laws and do according to them
Similar exhortation to keep the Lord's statutes and do according to them, with the affirmation 'I am the Lord'
Moses exhorts the people to keep the Lord's laws and commands
Command to carefully keep the Lord's commands, testimonies, and statutes
God's self-revelation 'I am the Lord' as the basis for obedience to his commands
Prophetic promise that God will give his Spirit so that people keep his commands and statutes
John teaches that love for God is shown by keeping his commands, and that his commands are not burdensome
Jesus teaches that those who love him keep his commands
